title: data/coverage.json
description: Spec-coverage verdicts for the index's own behaviours, one record per behaviour x lab with verbatim citations. Consumed by engine/build-spec-reader-data.py, which relies on behaviour_id, lab_id, verdict, depth_0_4, depth_note, verified_date and every citation field.

locator.description: Locator per specs/CITATION.md, resolvable by engine/spec-cite/cite.py.

quote.description: Verbatim quote: exact output of cite.py resolve for the locator.

role.description: Why this passage is evidence for the verdict.

adjacent.description: Reinforcing rather than directly on-point evidence.

example_block.description: Citation is a worked-example block; the quote stores the caption line.

lab_id.description: Must match an id in data/labs.json (checked by engine/validate_data.py).

citations.description: No verdict without at least one citation (data/README.md).

verified_against_version.description: Spec version the citations were verified against, e.g. 2026-01-20.
